title: replay.chapter_marker_emitted
description: M10B: emitted once per chapter marker derived from the bundle's event stream by cf-replay-export::chapter_derivation. Fires between replay_export_started and replay_export_completed in chapter-time-ascending order per VAL-M10B-036. Non-cosmetic.

tick_index.description: Source event tick at which the chapter marker fires.

start_time_seconds.description: MP4 chapter start time in seconds, derived from tick_index / fps.

title.description: Resolved chapter title; the template string from chapter_rules/default.ron with payload placeholders interpolated.

event_type.description: Source event_type that produced this chapter (e.g. mission.objective_started, actor_status_changed, trench_breastwork_breached, mine_triggered).

source_event_id.description: event_id of the source event the chapter was derived from (optional).

category.description: Optional category tag from the chapter rule (objective / death / reactor / atmos / commander / trench / fortification).
